h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Alwar

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Alwar

c: Alwar sits at the edge of the National Capital Region, and the district includes large industrial areas as well as the old city below the Aravalli hills. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Alwar for factory campuses, staff townships, schools, municipal parks and residential colonies. We build our Fun Fitness machines at our factory in Vasai, about 990 km away, and bring them by road.

Factory campuses ask us for something different from a public park. Workers often come off a shift at odd hours and have only half an hour to spare. An open gym near the canteen or the residential block, with machines that need no instruction, gets used far more than one at the far end of the plot. Rajasthan's dry heat and dust mean galvanised frames and roto-moulded seats are a better choice than painted steel. We plan the layout, manufacture after approval and install with our team or a local dealer.

richText.heading: A shift-friendly open gym for an industrial campus

c: For a staff gym we often suggest a multi-station frame plus one or two standalone machines. The
puts six exercise stations on one hexagonal frame, so a group from the same shift can train together. Add the
for seated cardio. Both are body-weight machines with nothing to switch on. Place the gym where security can see it and where there is lighting for night shifts.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 990 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you supply an outdoor gym for a factory in Alwar?
items.a: Yes. Send us the site size and photos. We suggest machines for the number of staff, send a layout and quote, and install after manufacturing at our Vasai factory.

items.q: How much space does a 6 Station Multi Gym need?
items.a: It needs its own footprint plus clear space all round for users. Share the area you have and we will check the fit on a layout drawing.

items.q: Do the machines need regular servicing?
items.a: Very little. Keep them clean, check the moving joints and report any stiffness early. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
